Directions: Based on the passage below and on your knowledge of social studies, answer each question that follows.
Content: It is impossible to tell whether prohibition is a good thing or a bad thing. It has never been enforced in this country.
There may not be as much liquor in quantity consumed to-day as there was before prohibition, but there is just as much alcohol. . . .
Copyright: Source: New York City Mayor Fiorello H. LaGuardia, Statement to Congress on the subject of Prohibition, `1926`
